_note: Hand-supplied prices. Merged by build-costs.ps1 and WINS over the dumps, so re-importing them never loses these.
_items_note: items: PER BATCH processing fee, by refinement path (same shape as the dumps). Index = refinement path, uc = fee for one batch, y = units that batch yields. This fee does NOT include the cost of the inputs.
_materials_note: materials: PER UNIT cost of a raw material you have to obtain. These are separate from the batch fees above and add on top. Evidence for per-unit: an Amyl Nitrite batch consumes exactly 1 Chemical Substances and the game lists its chemsub_cost as 35.5, the same order of magnitude as these.
_materials_keys: Keys must match the recipes' own spelling exactly - 'Chemical Substances' is capitalised there while the rest are lower case. Note 'chemicals' is a REFINED item, not this raw one.
_materials_global: Prices look colony-independent: silver quoted 73 at both Andromeda and Titan Station, iron 69 at both Necar's Field and Titan Station. So one number per material is enough - no per-site table needed.
